purpose: Actual closed-loop nominal composition ablation, no calibrated risk claim
independent: Each car uses its own cost/time predicted under its isolated learned-component profile; execute the resulting composed profile in closed loop
joint: Predict the complete three-actor profile; admit only if all vehicle cost/time differences are nonpositive and mean cost improves at least 0.05 seconds
source_of_confidence: Nominal model only, explicitly uncalibrated; this tests composition rather than a statistical guarantee
checkpoint_selection: The fixed complete 1701 policy, irrespective of the separate 1702 continuation
